notes: IP channels are inputs for up to 4 compatible Night Owl Wi-Fi devices.
Dimensions are stated as approximate (10 x 8 x 2 in).
Standalone DVR spec page gives a weight of approx. 2 lbs; system spec page gives approx. 2.7 lbs. Weight left out.
System spec page gives a pre-installed 1 TB hard drive; standalone spec page says the pre-installed drive varies by model and some models have none.
Spec pages list "16 x BNC / 4 x Wi-Fi" under the heading Audio Outputs; the values match the video channel counts and are not recorded as audio outputs.
